title: High-Throughput STS Microservice & Automated Continuous Training Pipeline
description: Directed the R&D and deployment of an end-to-end Semantic Textual Similarity (STS) system, encompassing custom benchmark dataset curation, multi-model fine-tuning, and an automated continuous training (CT) workflow for zero-downtime production deployment.
shortDescription: End-to-end STS system with automated continuous training and zero-downtime deployment
highlights: Curated and validated an in-house benchmark similarity dataset based on rigorous semantic metrics to guide domain-specific Transformer fine-tuning and model selection.
Engineered an automated Continuous Training (CT) and redeployment pipeline
Optimized transformer inference latency and resource footprint via asynchronous FastAPI microservice endpoints, meeting stringent real-time SLA thresholds.
